behavioral_effects: Auth cookies honor a COOKIE_SECURE runtime override, single-sourced in server-api.ts and consumed by all six auth handlers; the dev-stack frontend sets it false, so WebKit browsers stay authenticated over http localhost
Net-negative in the handlers: thirteen duplicated inline expressions replaced by one constant
compatibility_impact: Same variable name and semantics as the pending upstream template release, so the future upgrade converges on this instead of conflicting
follow_up: Next fix-issue candidates in order: auth.spec:96 (all browsers), mobile home/nav cluster, webkit auth:25
limitations: Remaining 16 e2e failures are separate causes: auth.spec:96 user-menu drift on all browsers, a mobile-viewport home/nav cluster, firefox flake, webkit invalid-credentials timing - each is its own session
reason: The containerized frontend runs a production build, so auth cookies are always Secure while the dev stack serves plain http on localhost - WebKit discards Secure cookies over http, silently unauthenticating Safari and Mobile Safari and failing 14 e2e tests; the fix adopts the COOKIE_SECURE env override the upstream template also introduces, so the pending upgrade converges rather than conflicts
rollback: git revert of the single commit, rebuild the frontend image
security_impact: Cookies stay Secure by default in production; COOKIE_SECURE=false is set only in the localhost dev override that already binds plain http on 127.0.0.1 - no production surface weakened
summary: Add a COOKIE_SECURE override so the dev-stack frontend works in WebKit

validators_run.evidence_ref: the targeted cluster cleared - all webkit and Mobile Safari chat failures gone; suite moved 29 failed/132 passed to 16 failed/144 passed
